We love Hondas so much we decided to race all our project cars on the mountain, Touge Style.
Big thank you to Hybrid racing for making this video possible. We’ve been running their parts for years. If you’ve got a Honda and want to take it to the next level, you gotta check them out if you haven’t already. They make bespoke parts and tons of other Honda performance parts.
Like working on cars? Check out our second channel Real Mechanic Stuff for more awesome videos
